variants.label: Icon
variants.tooltip: An image path to an icon, commonly used to augment a label or text property of a component by placing the icon next to it.

path.description: Shorthand path to icon source, in format: library/iconName

library.description: Optional alternative to 'path', name of library where icon is located. Must also supply 'name'.

name.description: Optional alternative to 'path', name of icon. Must also supply 'library'.

color.description: Color of the icon. Here for convenience, may instead assign 'fill' in the styles prop.

viewBox.description: Properties to assign to the 'viewBox' portion of the SVG that displays the icon.

x.description: The x value (amount to crop from the X axis) assigned to the 'viewBox' portion of the SVG that displays the icon.

y.description: The y value (amount to crop from the Y axis) assigned to the 'viewBox' portion of the SVG that displays the icon.

width.description: The width assigned to the 'viewBox' portion of the SVG that displays the icon.

height.description: The height assigned to the 'viewBox' portion of the SVG that displays the icon.
